ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Chief Coleman, Chair  Robert Gill, Commissioner
Andrea Eaton, Vice Chair  Jessica Gillette, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Barbara A. Pollack, Commissioner
Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56345  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, September 9, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56409  Recommendation to review and discuss the recent Commissioner Priorities Survey
  results and adopt an actionable work plan for the Commission’s top priorities
  moving into 2027 calendar year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56410  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Commission Responsibilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56411  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Investigative Protocol.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56412  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Social Media and Campaign Activity.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 4
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

6.  26-56413  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Ad Hoc Committee on Community
  Outreach’s presentation for neighborhood associations on the Office of Ethics and
  Transparency’s mission and the Commission’s jurisdiction and work.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56414  Recommendation to grant approval to all Commissioners to contact Long Beach
  neighborhood associations on behalf of the Commission and request time at an
  upcoming neighborhood association meeting to share the community outreach
  presentation created by the Ad Hoc Committee on Community Outreach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-56415  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-56416  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 26-56417  Recommendation to cancel the Ethics Commission regular meeting of Wednesday,
  November 11, 2026, and reschedule the meeting to a different day in November.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 26-56418  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
